about: How long sitting officeholders have served, for the careers behind the holders at the opening (OPUS-GOV, M1-14 part 2). Mean years in the office among those sitting at a point in time.

usHouseTenureYears.source: Congressional Research Service profile of the 118th Congress (2023): average length of service about 8.5 years for Representatives at the start of the Congress.

usSenateTenureYears.source: Congressional Research Service profile of the 118th Congress (2023): average length of service about 11.2 years for Senators at the start of the Congress.

stateLegislatorTenureYears.source: NCSL legislator turnover studies (roughly a quarter of seats turn over each two-year cycle, shorter in term-limited states): mean service near six years.

statewideExecutiveTenureYears.source: Governors and statewide officers commonly serve one or two four-year terms (National Governors Association former governors roster: most serve one or two terms).

localOfficialTenureYears.source: Estimated from National League of Cities city council member profiles (most members in their first or second term of two to four years); not checked against a fetched table.

minimumAgeAtFirstTerm.source: The youngest common minimum age for state legislative and local office (21 to 25 in most states; 18 in some localities).
